source: 103 original-art emoji in set/ + 10 reference crops (exploded/layout, = reference JPGs 01-10)
range_rule: 3rd-97th percentile of originals, widened by 15% of that span

offpalette_frac.label: share of feature pixels off the house palette

rules.faces_outline: face emoji keep the house outline (~10.5px @512, range in metrics.outline_px)
rules.symbols_outline: hearts and emotion symbols use a 13px outline @512 (metrics_symbol.outline_px)
rules.hearts_shading: hearts use the rich 4-stop radial gloss: white -> light -> base -> dark rim (#3a0010), plus white gloss ellipse upper-left
rules.symbol_size: emotion-subgroup symbols are fitted to a ~30px margin @512
rules.no_live_text: no <text> elements; lettering is converted to outlines (DejaVu Sans Bold, upright, no italic)
rules.motion_faces: head-shaking/shaking faces keep the faded ghost copies
rules.hands: hands are ~18% larger than the base part, with a ~5.5px dark (#24160a) outline and a soft 22% drop shadow; ALL hand faces (1fae3, 1fae1, 1fae2, 1f914) put the hands beside the eyes (variant C, Max 2026-10-14 20:52, overrides the earlier per-meaning exception), face expression parts kept intact, composite scaled to 86% so hands stay inside the margin
rules.mouths: every face needs a visible mouth in house style (tapered dark arc for slight smile/frown)
rules.pensive_vs_disappointed: 1f614 pensive = sad-slanted brows + small flat mouth; 1f61e disappointed = no brows + deep wide frown
rules.checker: face metrics only for face subgroups; non-yellow faces use metrics_nonyellow_face and skip yellow/gloss; dark runs >24px count as fill, not outline
rules.people: People & Body: skin uses set/qc/skin-tones.json 4-stop gloss (active palette pending decision); hands drawn with ~5.5px #24160a outline + 22% soft shadow; people/figures checked with metrics_people; tone variants named <cp>-<1f3fb..1f3ff>, ZWJ modifier after first codepoint
rules.hand_style: HOUSE HAND STYLE = R2 (Max 2026-10-14 21:20 PT): S1 sausage fingers, all equal width 25 (200-unit frame), round tips, 2-unit gaps, no creases/nails, soft white 50% highlight stripe along each finger; curled fingers stay as stacked R2 fingers; ~5.5px #24160a outline + 22% soft shadow; skin from skin-tones.json. Construction in set/parts/hands/ (S2, S3, S4, R1 and R3 rejected)
rules.skin_tones: Skin tones = palette B "balanced" in set/qc/skin-tones.json (Max 2026-10-14 21:26 PT); sheet and warm rejected
rules.woman: Women = original girl art with braids (template5/6 #122-127) adapted to adult: head scaled ~0.8 with a slightly longer face, purple-top bust/shoulders, braids kept, house gloss skin; in helmets/frames the same head is clipped into the visor (Max 2026-10-14 21:26 PT)
rules.pray: 1f64f = two R2 palms pressed together vertically, side view, fingers up, tilted ~8 degrees, small motion lines
rules.mouth_gradient: Mouth gradient overlays (tan/grey->white bars inside mouths) are drawn at 0.25 x their original opacity (Max 2026-10-14 21:27 PT); teeth/tongue base colours unchanged. Kiss mouths (1f617 1f618 1f619 1f61a 1f63d) are faded the same way and get a solid tapered #24160a "3" pucker stroke (~6->3px @512) on top (Max 21:38 PT). Implemented in set/work/mouthfix.py
rules.gesture_people: Gesture people (1f646 1f645 1f937 1f926 and future gesture figures) = G2 (Max 2026-10-14 21:47 PT): person head only, oversized floating R2 hands (~0.5 scale) close to the face, no arms; 1f645 hands cross in an X in front of the chin; 1f937 open palms up at shoulder height angled outward + raised brows; 1f646 hands meet over the head in an arc; 1f926 palm covers forehead and eyes; fitted to a 24px margin. G1/G3 rejected
rules.mixed_tone_pairs: A: each person keeps their own tone (per-person gradient via Ctx.tid); Max 2026-10-15 ~08:24 PT; B (both use first tone) and C (neutral yellow) rejected

family_layout.desc: Families: adults side by side with bust shoulders, kids tucked in front/below. Couples: side-view kiss with lips meeting + small heart (1f48f, *-2764-1f48b-*); facing side-view profiles with big heart (1f491, *-2764-*); holding hands = front busts with sleeved arms from shoulders to clasped R2 hands (1f46b/c/d, *-1f91d-*). Side-view hair has strands/sheen; women get a full plaited braid. Each person keeps own tone (mixed_tone_pairs). Holding-hands couples superseded by holding_hands rule (C2v4).

holding_hands.desc: Full-body v3a tall-slim stylized figures (narrow torso, shoulders wider than waist, tapered A-line dress, long legs), head gap halved (centres 106 apart in 200u), rubber-hose skin-tone arms hanging toward a clasp between bodies, round mitten hands incl. outer hands (exception to R2 house hand). Clean joints: single outline weight (stroke-under), shirt+sleeve caps unioned with one userSpace gradient, arm roots hidden in sleeves, arms clear of torso (no tangents/slivers), front mitten outline is the single seam, gloss off joints, chin overlaps neckline. Each person keeps own tone.
holding_hands.applies_to: 1f46b/1f46c/1f46d and every *-1f91d-* pairing incl. tone variants

kiss_couple_heart.desc: Kiss (1f48f, *-2764-1f48b-*) and couple-with-heart (1f491, *-2764-*): C2v4/v3a tall-slim bodies with arms hanging at sides + mitten hands, front-facing heads tilted toward each other touching lightly. Kiss = red kiss mark + small heart; heart couple = big heart. Mark x centred on measured head touch point (midpoint of left head right edge and right head left edge), not canvas centre. Clean-joint rules; each person keeps own tone. Kiss mark group (lips + small heart, proportional) scaled so its total height incl. outline equals the couple-heart height (36.8u at heart scale .4), same vertical centre as the heart, x on touch point (set/work/kissmark.py, 2026-10-15 10:30 PT). UPDATE 2026-10-15 12:14 PT (Max approved): lips alone (incl. outline) = heart height 36.8u, stretched sx 1.172 / sy 1.465 (width 49.2u), outline compensated ~2.4u, lower-lip gloss; small heart (scale .16) tucked at upper-right corner of lips; lips at heart vertical centre on touch point (set/work/lipstall.py, lt_apply.py). Supersedes the kiss-group-height rule.

animals_style.desc: Animals & Nature: glossy round smiley-like heads/blobs with house eyes (4-stop radial gloss gradient, thick dark outline, top-left white gloss). Plants also as glossy blobs with faces (S1). Clean-joint rules apply (union same-colour parts, front outline wins, no stacked strokes). Dark fur (e.g. black cat 1f408-200d-2b1b): near-black fur keeps a subtle lighter rim just inside the outline (r 62.5-66 of the 66 head) so the house outline reads and measures at weight; checker unchanged (it was not a checker bug: the rim was too far inside). Per-emoji outline overrides (ow) compensate for fit-scaling on very wide/spiky silhouettes: camels 12, ox/llama 11.5, buffalo 10, wolf 8, paw prints 7 (in 200u space).

animals_bird.desc: Template for all birds: S1 round body with wings and tuft unioned into the silhouette (same colour, one userSpace gradient), feathers as thin inner lines, pale belly patch inside, house eyes, small beak.

animals_fish.desc: Template for all fish / marine side-view creatures: true side view, body+tail+fins one union (single outline, one gradient), one big house eye toward the front with clear spacing from mouth and edge, mouth at nose tip, small blush, inner lines for gill/fin rays.

animals_hooves.desc: Hoofed full-body animals: small hooves, lower leg in fur/leg colour unioned to the body (clean joint, overlapping bottom edge), darker hoof tip (hoofc #9a7a5a/#3a2414). Cloven animals (cattle, goat, sheep, deer, pig, camel, giraffe, hippo...) get a split-toe notch; horse, donkey, zebra, unicorn, rhino get a solid hoof.

animals_buck_teeth.desc: Buck teeth are ONE part: two equal incisors as one rounded-bottom rect (r=4), white with subtle gloss; house-weight outline on sides+bottom only (NO top stroke, butt ends on the mouth line); thin centre divider starting at the top edge; mouth line is two curls at the sides only, meeting the side strokes. Sits just under the nose/mouth, never over whisker/muzzle outlines; replaces the smile. Applies to hamster, mice, rat, rabbits, chipmunk, beaver.

animals_dark_fur_rim.desc: Near-black fur (e.g. black cat) gets a light rim ring (#8a8a9e) right at the inner edge of the outline (r 64.2 on the r64 head) so the outline reads and QC measures it correctly.

animals_nostrils.desc: Nostrils sit on the upper muzzle, never at the bottom: long muzzle y142, broad muzzle y134 (200-unit space).

process_self_review.desc: STANDING PROCESS RULE for every batch: build -> self-critique every emoji at 160px and 72px against the house reference style (locked sets) -> fix all weak spots identified -> re-run QC (0 flags) and verify locks -> repeat until clean. Only then report to Max, listing just the remaining issues that genuinely could not be fixed (with reasons).

plants_faces.desc: Plants (flowers, trees, leaves, food produce by extension unless Max says otherwise) are drawn WITHOUT faces.

plants_highlights.desc: Per-part crisp highlights lit from the upper left: each highlight is a clean white shape (opacity ~.6) inside its own part following its form (lens on a leaf's upper-left edge, shrunk/clipped copy of a round part, or a short arc/stroke). No soft white group hotspot in the gradient (plants gradients start at the light colour). Separate parts get their own gradient. Drop highlights that cannot be read at 72px. Implementation: set/work/plants.py (hl, leafhl, UH, UE, _nohot).

highlights_never_on_stroke.applies: all batches from food-batch-01 v2 onward
highlights_never_on_stroke.desc: Highlights (shine) must stay off the OUTER silhouette outline of every part (the dark ink edge stroke, incl. stem/tube outlines), with a margin of half the stroke width + ~3px. Highlights MAY overlap internal strokes (kernel grids, seed rings, veins, ridges, markings, ink dots) - 'if the stroke is not on the edge then its ok, like the corn'. Implementation: set/work/food.py nostroke() subtracts only ink outline strokes buffered by stroke/2 + 1.4u (~3.4px at 512) from each highlight (shapely, pure vector). Audit: set/work/hlaudit.py counts highlight pixels within 2px of visible ink-outline pixels only; must be 0.

food_fidelity_v3.applies: all Food & Drink batches from batch 02 v3 onward
food_fidelity_v3.desc: Food uses the v3 fidelity standard: smooth multi-point organic outlines (Catmull-Rom beziers through 8-24 anchors, slight hand-drawn irregularity on round items; no bare rectangles/polygons), a lower-right form-shade crescent inside each main part (part minus itself offset up-left, darker gradient stop at ~35% opacity, inset from the outline), and texture details (crumb pores, scoring, seeds, grain, marbling, blisters, flecks). Implementation: set/work/prepared3.py sm(), wob(), shade(), part().
